newsitem.title: USA: Fedex to acquire new Airbus, used McDonnell planes.
newsitem.headline: Fedex to acquire new Airbus, used McDonnell planes.

text.p: Federal Express Corp. said Tuesday it will acquire 11 new A300-600 aircraft from Airbus Industrie to keep pace with strong growth in its express package delivery business.
Terms of the purchase were not disclosed.

Separately, FedEx would conclude "in the next few days" a multi-million dollar deal to acquire up to 50 second-hand McDonnell Douglas DC-10-10s from American Airlines and United Airlines, FedEx Vice-President James Parker said.
He said all the aircraft would be converted to cargo configuration by McDonell Douglas at the aircraft manufacturer's Long Beach, Calif. facility.
"We're acquiring these additional aircraft in order to meet the long-term demands of the FedEx network," said Gil Mook, FedEx's senior vice president of air operations, in a statement.
The new A300-600 aircraft, which will be used primarily within the United States, feature high reliability and fuel efficiency and meet stringent noise abatement requirements, it said.
Airbus will deliver the 11 new A300-600 aircraft over a three-year period beginning in fiscal 1999.
